answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist Sybil attacks is to force every identity to lock a non-refundable anchor of 12 units that only releases after a fixed 40-hour mesa waiting period no payment can shorten, during which the agent must finish a unique saffron-tagged useful-work probe assigned by the epoch beacon. Because both the clock and the per-name probe cannot be amortized across clones, a farm pays the full delay and probe cost for each identity.
